intro.title: White Studio Games
intro.lede: Data link establishing. Cabinets coming online.
naru.tip_welcome: Hi, I'm Naru! Welcome to the White Studio Games arcade floor.
naru.tip_cabinets: Arcade cabinets below for high scores — party games with friends are in the next row.
naru.tip_party: Color Chain and Draw & Guess — open a room and play together.
naru.tip_discord: Discord login is optional for identity. Guests can still play.
naru.tip_snake_controls: Swipe or tap the pad to turn. Switching apps auto-pauses.
naru.tip_snake_submit: After a run, submit your score. Any nickname works.
naru.tip_snake_back: Want the lobby? Use Back in the top-left.
naru.tip_color_chain_entry: Tap Quick play for a random room — AI joins so you can start now.
naru.tip_color_chain_join: Enter a friend’s room code, or open their share link.
naru.tip_color_chain_invite_settings: Pick player count and AI fill, then Create room.
naru.tip_color_chain_invite_wait: Share the code or link, then Start when you’re ready.
naru.tip_color_chain_your_turn: Glow-edged cards are playable; otherwise draw from the pile.
naru.tip_color_chain_last: Call “last card” when you have one left — or rivals can catch you!
naru.tip_color_chain_challenge: Challenge a fresh +4 — the reveal hand makes the call transparent.
naru.tip_color_chain_result: Winners can submit a score. Rematch anytime.
naru.tip_sketch_chain_entry: Create a room, then share the code so friends can join the same chain.
naru.tip_sketch_chain_join: Got a code or link? Enter it here to join the same room.
naru.tip_sketch_chain_invite_wait: Copy the link for friends — the host starts when everyone’s in.
naru.tip_sketch_chain_start: At least two players — host taps Start when you’re ready.
naru.tip_sketch_chain_write: Round one: write a silly prompt others will draw!
naru.tip_sketch_chain_draw: Draw on the canvas — the page won’t scroll while you sketch.
naru.tip_sketch_chain_reveal: Sit back — every chain auto-reveals together. Prepare to laugh.
naru.tip_sketch_chain_again: Want another round? Hit play again and gather the crew.
hub.hero_lede: Black-purple neon floor. Pick a cabinet, play a round, climb the board — Discord login optional.
hub.play_lede: Arcade and realtime tables share the same shell and API contract.
hub.section_arcade_lede: Score-chase cabinets. Climb the leaderboard after each run.
hub.section_party_lede: Group play with friends — realtime rooms, no scoreboard required.
hub.card_body: Classic grid snake. Eat neon bites (+10), grow longer, climb the board.
hub.card_color_chain_body: Realtime four-color chain battles. Challenge +4s, call last card.
hub.card_sketch_chain_body: Write, draw, guess — pass the sketch and watch chains go off the rails.
hub.catalog_offline: Catalog API offline — showing local cabinet. ({error})
hub.footer_about: Other White Studio services — coming soon as About.
